sections.title: Stems and habit
sections.text: Rhipsalis pilocarpa is a Brazilian epiphytic cactus with slender cylindrical shoots that become pendent. Short segments are grouped near the tips, and the areoles bear fine, pale bristles.

sections.title: Flowers and fruit
sections.text: Solitary or paired white flowers open near the ends of shoots and measure about 2.5–4 cm across. The spherical fruit is wine-red and bristly, up to about 12 mm wide.

sections.title: Image comparison
sections.text: The illustrated cylindrical, finely bristled stems, terminal white blooms and hairy red fruit match this species. No dependable food use is established by the cited botanical account.
